podcast.body: Released on March 11, 2009, this seven-inch single was the first ever proper release from Jack White's Third Man Records, marking a significant moment for the nascent indie label. "It's a seven-year single from the Dead Weather released on March 11, 2009. It's Hang You From The Heavens."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song was released as a 7-inch single by Jack White's Third Man Records for Record Store Day in 2009. "It's a seven inch single from Jack White's third man records and features his band Dead Weather with Hang You from the Heavens."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song serves as the A-side of a 7-inch record, which bears the catalog number TMR001. The record was acquired from Jack White's Third Man Record Store in Nashville. "The A side is the deadweathers hanging from the heavens."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
